descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S15 Both devices edit the same pre-round note: nobody's words are lost

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh. (TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Phone has {hospitalPatient}'s pre-round editor open with its own autosaved line A

When The computer opens the same chart, adds line B and taps Save Note. The phone, editor still open, adds line C and waits 3 s. Run in both modes

Then The phone's open editor shows B without a refresh, and at the end the stored note holds A, B and C. Neither device's words are lost

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone editor, no reload) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-B' (Q4: whether an open editor must update); cp2 (computer, chart open, no reload or tap; Save Note closed its editor, so this reads the 60-character row) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-B' and 'QA-SYNC-PR-C'; …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
